title: Continue
errorMessage: This interim response indicates that the client should continue with the request. If your request is already finished, you can safely ignore this response.
userMessage: Your request is being processed. Please wait for the final response.

title: Switching Protocols
errorMessage: This code is sent in response to a request for upgrading the connection. It indicates that the server is switching to a different protocol as requested by the client.
userMessage: The server is now switching to a different communication protocol, which may enhance your experience.

title: Processing
errorMessage: This code indicates that the server has received and is currently processing the request, but no response is available yet.
userMessage: Your request is being processed. Please be patient as we work to provide you with a response.

title: Early Hints
errorMessage: This status code is primarily used with the Link header, allowing the user agent to start preloading resources while the server prepares the final response.
userMessage: We’re getting things ready for you. Some resources are being preloaded to enhance your experience.

title: Ok
errorMessage: The request succeeded, and the server has returned the requested data.
userMessage: Your request was successful! Here’s the information you requested.

title: Created
errorMessage: The request succeeded, and a new resource was created as a result. This is typically the response sent after POST requests, or some PUT requests.
userMessage: Your request was successful! A new resource has been created.

title: Accepted
errorMessage: The request has been received but not yet acted upon. It is noncommittal, since there is no way in HTTP to later send an asynchronous response indicating the outcome of the request.
userMessage: Your request has been received and is being processed. We will update you once it's completed.

title: Non-Authoritative Information
errorMessage: This response code means the returned metadata is not exactly the same as is available from the origin server, but is collected from a local or a third-party copy.
userMessage: The information provided may not be the latest or from the original source. Please check back for the most accurate details.

title: No Content
errorMessage: There is no content to send for this request, but the headers may be useful. The user agent may update its cached headers for this resource with the new ones.
userMessage: The request was successful, but there's no new information to display.

title: Reset Content
errorMessage: Tells the user agent to reset the document which sent this request.
userMessage: The request was successful. Please reset the document to reflect any changes.

title: Partial Content
errorMessage: This response code is used when the Range header is sent from the client to request only part of a resource.
userMessage: The request was successful, and only part of the resource has been returned.

title: Multi-Status
errorMessage: Conveys information about multiple resources, for situations where multiple status codes might be appropriate.
userMessage: The request involved multiple resources, and the response includes their statuses.

title: Already Reported
errorMessage: Used inside a <dav:propstat> response element to avoid repeatedly enumerating the internal members of multiple bindings to the same collection.
userMessage: The resource has already been reported, avoiding redundancy in the response.

title: IM Used (HTTP Delta encoding)
errorMessage: The server has fulfilled a GET request for the resource, and the response is a representation of the result of one or more instance-manipulations applied to the current instance.
userMessage: The request was successful, and the response reflects changes made to the resource.

title: Multiple Choices
errorMessage: The request has more than one possible response. The user agent or user should choose one of them. (There is no standardized way of choosing one of the responses, but HTML links to the possibilities are recommended so the user can pick.)
userMessage: Multiple options are available for your request. Please choose one to proceed.

title: Moved Permanently
errorMessage: The URL of the requested resource has been changed permanently. The new URL is given in the response.
userMessage: The resource has moved permanently. You will be redirected to the new location.

title: Found
errorMessage: This response code means that the URI of the requested resource has been changed temporarily. Further changes in the URI might be made in the future. Therefore, this same URI should be used by the client in future requests.
userMessage: The resource has been temporarily moved. Please follow the redirect.

title: See Other
errorMessage: The server sent this response to direct the client to get the requested resource at another URI with a GET request.
userMessage: You need to go to a different location to access the requested resource.

title: Not Modified
errorMessage: This is used for caching purposes. It tells the client that the response has not been modified, so the client can continue to use the same cached version of the response.
userMessage: No changes have been made since your last request. You can use the cached version.

title: Use Proxy
errorMessage: Defined in a previous version of the HTTP specification to indicate that a requested response must be accessed by a proxy. It has been deprecated due to security concerns regarding in-band configuration of a proxy.
userMessage: Access to the resource requires a proxy, but this method is outdated and not recommended.

title: Unused
errorMessage: This response code is no longer used; it is just reserved. It was used in a previous version of the HTTP/1.1 specification.
userMessage: This status code is reserved and not currently in use.

title: Temporary Redirect
errorMessage: The server sends this response to direct the client to get the requested resource at another URI with the same method that was used in the prior request. This has the same semantics as the 302 Found HTTP response code, with the exception that the user agent must not change the HTTP method used: if a POST was used in the first request, a POST must be used in the second request.
userMessage: The resource has been temporarily moved. Please use the same method for the redirected request.

title: Permanent Redirect
errorMessage: This means that the resource is now permanently located at another URI, specified by the Location: HTTP Response header. This has the same semantics as the 301 Moved Permanently HTTP response code, with the exception that the user agent must not change the HTTP method used: if a POST was used in the first request, a POST must be used in the second request.
userMessage: The resource has moved permanently. Please use the same method for the redirected request.

title: Bad Request
errorMessage: The server cannot or will not process the request due to something that is perceived to be a client error (e.g., malformed request syntax, invalid request message framing, or deceptive request routing).
userMessage: Bad Request. Please check your request and try again.

title: Unauthorized
errorMessage: Although the HTTP standard specifies unauthorized, semantically this response means unauthenticated. That is, the client must authenticate itself to get the requested response.
userMessage: You need to log in to access this resource.

title: Payment Required
errorMessage: This response code is reserved for future use. The initial aim for creating this code was using it for digital payment systems, however this status code is used very rarely and no standard convention exists.
userMessage: Payment is required for this request, but this feature is not commonly used.

title: Forbidden
errorMessage: The client does not have access rights to the content; that is, it is unauthorized, so the server is refusing to give the requested resource. Unlike 401 Unauthorized, the client's identity is known to the server.
userMessage: You don't have permission to access this resource. Please check your credentials.

title: Not Found
errorMessage: The server can not find the requested resource. In the browser, this means the URL is not recognized. In an API, this can also mean that the endpoint is valid but the resource itself does not exist.
userMessage: The requested resource could not be found. Please check the URL.

title: Method Not Allowed
errorMessage: The request method is known by the server but is not supported by the target resource.
userMessage: The request method is not allowed for this resource. Please check the allowed methods.

title: Not Acceptable
errorMessage: This response is sent when the web server, after performing server-driven content negotiation, doesn't find any content that conforms to the criteria given by the user agent.
userMessage: The requested resource is not available in a format that your request accepts.

title: Proxy Authentication Required
errorMessage: This is similar to 401 Unauthorized but authentication is needed to be done by a proxy.
userMessage: Proxy authentication is required to access this resource.

title: Request Timeout
errorMessage: This response is sent on an idle connection by some servers, even without any previous request by the client.
userMessage: The server timed out waiting for your request. Please try again.

title: Conflict
errorMessage: This response is sent when a request conflicts with the current state of the server.
userMessage: There was a conflict with your request. Please check your data and try again.

title: Gone
errorMessage: This response is sent when the requested content has been permanently deleted from the server, with no forwarding address.
userMessage: The requested resource is no longer available. It has been permanently removed.

title: Length Required
errorMessage: Server rejected the request because the Content-Length header field is not defined and the server requires it.
userMessage: Content-Length header is required. Please include it in your request.

title: Precondition Failed
errorMessage: The client has indicated preconditions in its headers which the server does not meet.
userMessage: Your request includes conditions that were not met. Please revise your request.

title: Payload Too Large
errorMessage: Request entity is larger than limits defined by server.
userMessage: Your request is too large. Please reduce the size and try again.

title: URI Too Long
errorMessage: The URI requested by the client is longer than the server is willing to interpret.
userMessage: The requested URL is too long. Please shorten it and try again.

title: Unsupported Media Type
errorMessage: The media format of the requested data is not supported by the server, so the server is rejecting the request.
userMessage: The format of your request is not supported. Please check the media type.

title: Range Not Satisfiable
errorMessage: The range specified by the Range header field in the request cannot be fulfilled.
userMessage: The requested range cannot be satisfied. Please check your request.

title: Expectation Failed
errorMessage: This response code means the expectation indicated by the Expect request header field cannot be met by the server.
userMessage: The server cannot meet the expectations specified in your request.

title: I'm a teapot
errorMessage: The server refuses the attempt to brew coffee with a teapot.
userMessage: This server is a teapot and refuses to make coffee.

title: Misdirected Request
errorMessage: The request was directed at a server that is not able to produce a response.
userMessage: Your request was sent to the wrong server. Please try again.

title: Unprocessable Entity
errorMessage: The request was well-formed but was unable to be followed due to semantic errors.
userMessage: Your request was well-formed but contains semantic errors. Please check your data.

title: Locked
errorMessage: The resource that is being accessed is locked.
userMessage: The requested resource is locked and cannot be accessed at this time.

title: Failed Dependency
errorMessage: The request failed due to failure of a previous request.
userMessage: This request failed due to a previous request not succeeding.

title: Too Early
errorMessage: Indicates that the server is unwilling to risk processing a request that might be replayed.
userMessage: The server is not ready to process your request yet. Please try again later.

title: Upgrade Required
errorMessage: The server refuses to perform the request using the current protocol but might be willing to do so after the client upgrades to a different protocol.
userMessage: An upgrade to a different protocol is required to process your request.

title: Precondition Required
errorMessage: The origin server requires the request to be conditional.
userMessage: This request must be conditional to prevent conflicts. Please revise your request.

title: Too Many Requests
errorMessage: The user has sent too many requests in a given amount of time (rate limiting).
userMessage: You have sent too many requests in a short period. Please wait and try again.

title: Request Header Fields Too Large
errorMessage: The server is unwilling to process the request because its header fields are too large.
userMessage: Your request headers are too large. Please reduce their size and try again.

title: Unavailable For Legal Reasons
errorMessage: The user agent requested a resource that cannot legally be provided, such as a web page censored by a government.
userMessage: This resource is not available for legal reasons.

title: Internal Server Error
errorMessage: The server has encountered a situation it does not know how to handle.
userMessage: An internal server error has occurred. Please try again later.

title: Not Implemented
errorMessage: The request method is not supported by the server and cannot be handled.
userMessage: The server does not support the functionality required to fulfill your request.

title: Bad Gateway
errorMessage: This error response means that the server, while working as a gateway to get a response needed to handle the request, got an invalid response.
userMessage: The server received an invalid response from the upstream server. Please try again.

title: Service Unavailable
errorMessage: The server is not ready to handle the request, often due to maintenance or overload.
userMessage: The service is currently unavailable. Please try again later.

title: Gateway Timeout
errorMessage: This error response is given when the server is acting as a gateway and cannot get a response in time.
userMessage: The server timed out waiting for a response from another server. Please try again.

title: HTTP Version Not Supported
errorMessage: The HTTP version used in the request is not supported by the server.
userMessage: The HTTP version used in your request is not supported. Please check your request.

title: Variant Also Negotiates
errorMessage: The server has an internal configuration error: the chosen variant resource is configured to engage in transparent content negotiation itself.
userMessage: An internal server error occurred due to configuration issues. Please try again later.

title: Insufficient Storage
errorMessage: The method could not be performed on the resource because the server is unable to store the representation needed to successfully complete the request.
userMessage: The server has insufficient storage to process your request. Please try again later.

title: Loop Detected
errorMessage: The server detected an infinite loop while processing the request.
userMessage: An infinite loop was detected while processing your request. Please try again.

title: Not Extended
errorMessage: Further extensions to the request are required for the server to fulfill it.
userMessage: Your request requires additional extensions that are not provided. Please check your request.

title: Network Authentication Required
errorMessage: Indicates that the client needs to authenticate to gain network access.
userMessage: Network authentication is required. Please authenticate and try again.
